faqs.question: How is my fertile window calculated?
faqs.answer: We use your logged cycle length, period start dates, and symptoms to estimate ovulation and the days around it when conception is most likely.

faqs.question: How do I log symptoms?
faqs.answer: Tap the + button in the tab bar, or use “Log today” on Home. Pick your mood and symptoms, then save. You can edit them any time the same day.

faqs.question: Can I export my cycle data?
faqs.answer: Yes. Go to Settings › Doctor report to create a PDF of your cycles, symptoms and temperature that you can share with your doctor.

faqs.question: How do I change my cycle length?
faqs.answer: Open Settings › Cycle preferences and update your average cycle length. Predictions adjust as you log more cycles.

privacyPolicy.note: Your health data is encrypted and never sold to third parties.

sections.title: Data we collect
sections.body: We collect the cycle, symptom, and profile information you choose to log, along with basic device information to keep the app running smoothly.

sections.title: How we use your data
sections.body: Your data powers personalized predictions and recommendations. We never share identifiable health data with advertisers.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: You can export or permanently delete your data at any time from Settings. Contact us if you have questions about how your information is handled.
